en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large European city square showing a military parade. Hundreds of soldiers with rifles and bayonets march in formation across a broad cobbled plaza with tram tracks in the foreground. On the right stands a large, ornate civic building with columns, arches, and a steep roof, while on the left and in the background are multi‑story 19th‑century townhouses and commercial buildings lining the square.
